fusions.name: Downdraft Slam
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Skyfall Weight
fusions.desc: Throws a weight that deals 30 damage to the first enemy in its path, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Hauled by the Haft
fusions.desc: The swung head carries you 5 tiles forward. For 3 seconds after you land, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Running Wind-Up
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
